title: TikTok Business Manager Explained: Setup, Login, and How It Differs From Ads Manager
summary: Confused by TikTok Business Manager, Business Center, and Ads Manager? See what each tool does, how to set up and log in, and how agencies manage multiple client accounts.
body_markdown:
## Running Multiple Client Accounts: The Agency Workflow Native Docs Ignore


Agencies managing several clients need a repeatable process for access, asset assignment, and staff changes. Avoid sharing passwords or relying on separate devices for each profile. Each client should retain ownership of its business assets and grant agency staff only the access needed for assigned work. This makes account changes easier to review and reduces confusion when staff move between clients.


### Managing 10+ Client TikTok Accounts From One Business Center (No Room Full of Phones)


For each new client, have the client’s administrator grant access to the relevant business workspace and advertising assets. Document the client name, assigned account, agency users, and approval contact in your internal workflow. A campaign manager can then use the appropriate client asset without relying on a shared personal login. Keep client records distinct so campaign updates, billing questions, and access requests reach the right owner.


### Agency Permission Structure: Granting Access Without Sprawl


Assign access by responsibility, not convenience. Give administration rights only to staff who manage members or business assets; give campaign staff the permissions needed for advertising tasks. Review access when responsibilities change, and ask the client to approve permissions that require client-side ownership. Clear roles prevent broad access from lasting beyond a project or spreading across unrelated accounts.


### Offboarding Clients and Partners Cleanly: Revoking Assets the Right Way


Make access removal part of the offboarding checklist. Confirm the handoff with the client, identify agency members and partner accounts tied to the work, and ask the appropriate administrator to remove access that is no longer needed. Check that ownership and billing responsibilities remain with the client, then record the date and assets reviewed.


- Confirm the client’s ongoing account owner and administrator.
- List agency members and partner access connected to the client.
- Request removal of permissions no longer required.
- Verify the handoff of campaign records and outstanding tasks.


### Where Native Tooling Stops: The Creator-Volume Gap


Business workspaces and ad tools organize accounts and campaigns, but they do not replace a dedicated process for recruiting and managing affiliate creators at scale. Teams that need creator discovery, personalized outreach, sample tracking, and ongoing relationship management need workflows built for those tasks. The FastMoss TikTok Data Analytics Platform offers creator analytics, competitor performance tracking, product discovery, viral trend detection, and live performance tracking, with a data accuracy with 90% reliability guarantee. It is an analytics option for teams assessing creator and content signals, not a substitute for Business Center access administration.
